packages/client/src/client/account-envir.reason: Host relationship enrollment poll; moves to the relationships resource event in #4609.

packages/client/src/client/connection-pr.reason: Diagnostic log tail while the connection panel is open and visible; #4609 decides between a stream and a kept poll.

packages/client/src/client/create-app-fo.reason: WeChat QR setup attempt: the scan happens on the external platform, which has no event source we can follow; stops once the attempt settles.

packages/client/src/client/device-reques.reason: Pending device keys; moves to the devices resource event in #4609.

packages/client/src/client/dm-composer-c.reason: Bot context in the DM composer; moves to turn-end and context-change refresh in #4609.

packages/client/src/client/engine-choice.reason: Browser sign-in for a Subscription Engine completes outside the client. The Host exposes CLI login status only through a read. Polling stops when sign-in succeeds or after three minutes.

packages/client/src/client/live-snapshot.reason: Waits 5 s to reconnect when the live snapshot stream fails.

packages/client/src/client/private-accou.reason: Private account status while configuring; moves to the private-inputs resource event in #4609.

packages/client/src/client/private-input.reason: Private input status while pending; moves to the private-inputs resource event in #4609.

packages/client/src/client/remote-viewer.reason: Samples the remote viewer iframe DOM to detect a frozen stream; local page state, no Host read.

packages/client/src/client/tool-approval.reason: Tool approval execution state while waiting; moves to an execution-state event in #4609.

packages/client/src/client/user-question.reason: User question status right after submit; moves to a status event in #4609.

packages/host-client/src/client.ts.reason: Reopens a followed channel stream 1 s after the Host ends it while the client is still following.
